title: om.cue entry
description: One cue given after a tool call (docs/brain-memory.md, decision 4; docs/memory-v2.md, "Cues"): the record it pointed at, the key that matched (kind:value) and the latest compaction before it ("" before the first). The om.cue entries after the latest compaction are the cues' delivery state. Only the neutral store holds it. Source: memory/extract/cue.go (CueData), memory/cli/hook.go (cue), lisp/src/server/hooks.lisp (post-tool).
